parameters.query: SELECT id, pillar, hook, body, image_brief, image_title, image_points FROM content_posts WHERE approval_status = 'needs_review' AND image_path IS NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ post_id: $('Select Draft').first().json.id, title: $('Select Draft').first().json.image_title || $('Select Draft').first().json.hook, points: $('Select Draft').first().json.image_points || [], body: $('Select Draft').first().json.body, pillar: $('Select Draft').first().json.pillar }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE content_posts SET image_path = $2, image_model = $3, token_usage = COALESCE(token_usage, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('image', NULLIF($4, '')::jsonb) WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id AS post_id, hook, body, cta, hashtags, image_path, approval_status;
